subject: Upcoming Travel Plans
body: Dear Team, I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to inform you that I will be traveling to New York next month for a business conference. I have already booked my flight and hotel accommodations. I will be out of the office from June 15th to June 18th. Please let me know if there are any urgent matters that need to be addressed before my departure. Thank you for your understanding. Best regards, [Your Name]
